name: Tantra
blurb: The Operations Club — events and activities on operations management that connect students to the resources, careers and alumni network shaping how the business world really runs.

name: Technology Club
blurb: Where every student gets engaged in tech — knowledge, networks and a practical playground for invention, resourcefulness and innovation. A place to master coding and stop fearing the debugger.

name: Nexus — AI & Robotics
blurb: Explores new technologies and supports deep research — training students to build, prototype and showcase creative work in AI and robotics.

name: Ignite
blurb: The Entrepreneurship Club — intensive founder skills, real business-world exposure, and a platform to run ventures and compete in external entrepreneurship forums.

name: Finwiz
blurb: The community for finance enthusiasts — learn, share and network with industry to make informed financial choices and build the skills to act on them.

name: Arthaverse
blurb: The economics society — policy debates, research papers, and macro reading groups.

name: Marketing Director's Club
blurb: Brand strategy, growth experiments and case competitions for marketing-minded students.

name: Humanique
blurb: The HR Club — a year-round continuum of activities to help students build a compelling personality, sharpen domain knowledge and grow their network.

name: Spectrum
blurb: The performing arts society — music, theatre and stagecraft for every campus event.

name: Jashn
blurb: The Cultural Club — sparks the creative, fun side of campus through festivals all year, from Bollytolly Retro Fest to Bollytolly Ethnic Fest.

name: Just Naach
blurb: Woxsen's Dance Club — a stage to showcase originality and explore every dance form, built to lift student morale through movement.

name: Distortion
blurb: The campus rock & alt-music collective — bands, jam rooms and live nights.

name: Crowdcore
blurb: The Marketing Club — the art and science of limitless marketing, surfacing the most innovative and unconventional techniques through events and blogs that upskill aspiring marketers.

name: Drishyakala
blurb: The film club — Friday screenings, short film productions and the annual student film festival.

name: Paparazzi
blurb: The Photography & Media Club — composition, artistic expression and the crew documenting campus life, sport and culture from a to z.

name: Skribble
blurb: Where students who share a love for art gather, work with a wide range of materials and techniques, and find creative expression beyond the classroom.

name: Woxsen Design Club
blurb: Visual identity, product design and the team that ships work for campus events.

name: Visual Communication Club
blurb: Introduces students to digital media — thought-provoking visuals, stimulating motion graphics and captivating stories.

name: Fashion Club
blurb: Taps into every fashion department and explores different fashion realms — a community where experiments are appreciated and nobody's afraid to try something new.

name: Interior Design Club
blurb: A co-curricular forum to swap ideas on materials, trends, innovations and the aesthetics of space — exploring the workings of design hands-on.

name: Aesthetrix
blurb: The Product Design Club — function-first design made visible, with sketching and collaborative making at the core of how members learn and improve.

name: James A.F. Stoner Global Sustainability Club
blurb: Builds a community of environmentally conscious leaders — driving change through Collaboration, Research and Engagement on and beyond campus.

name: Rotaract Club
blurb: Empowers young leaders through service projects and leadership labs — promoting social responsibility, sustainable development and a culture of empathy.

name: Animal Welfare Club
blurb: Looks after the animals living on campus — care, food, regular vet check-ups and vaccination drives, building a community grounded in kindness.

name: The Law Club
blurb: Moot courts, legal aid clinics and the journal of student jurisprudence.

name: Literature Club
blurb: A book a month, daily reading and writing — building cognitive sharpness, verbal craft and the intellectual life of campus on commitment, curiosity and critical thinking.

name: Genesis
blurb: The psychology & behavioural science circle — talks, experiments and reading groups.

name: Utopia
blurb: Speculative design and futures thinking — building the campus of tomorrow.

name: 60cm Janspadan
blurb: Folk arts, regional crafts and traditions — celebrating India's cultural diversity.
